title: Reinforcement Learning with Pairwise Preferences in Long-Term Decision Problems
abstract: arXiv:2606.00367v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with scalar rewards is widely used for aligning machine-learning systems with user preferences. But, pairwise preferences are often more natural for users to specify than scalar rewards, and they express certain goals that scalar rewards cannot. Methods for reinforcement learning with pairwise preferences have thus received growing interest. Unfortunately, these methods are inefficient in problems with long time horizons, and they lack guarantees on the performance of Markov policies relative to history-dependent policies, which bridge the theory and practice of reinforcement learning. We address these limitations in a new problem setting for reinforcement learning with pairwise preferences called the \textit{Markov decision contest}. translated_title: 长期决策问题中基于成对偏好的强化学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.00367v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：基于标量奖励的强化学习被广泛用于将机器学习系统与用户偏好对齐。然而，成对偏好通常比标量奖励更自然地为用户所指定，并且它们能表达标量奖励无法实现的目标。因此，基于成对偏好的强化学习方法受到了越来越多的关注。不幸的是，这些方法在长时间跨度的问题中效率低下，并且缺乏关于马尔可夫策略相对于历史依赖策略性能的保证，而这一点连接了强化学习的理论与实践。我们通过一种新的问题设置——称为“马尔可夫决策竞赛”——来解决这些限制，用于基于成对偏好的强化学习。在此设置中，我们证明了平稳马尔可夫策略的性能与历史依赖策略相当；并且精确恢复最优策略的问题属于NP类（即属于计算复杂度类NP）。
tldr: 本文提出了“马尔可夫决策竞赛”这一新问题设置，证明平稳马尔可夫策略在长期成对偏好强化学习中与历史依赖策略性能相当，并明确了最优策略恢复的计算复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new problem setting called "Markov decision contests" for pairwise preference reinforcement learning, proving that stationary Markov policies perform as well as history-dependent policies in long-term settings and characterizing the computational complexity of recovering an optimal policy.
